dedupe_keys.name: research data for probabilistic assessment of renewable hosting capacity under dynamic line rating in medium voltage distribution networks

description: University of Zaragoza researchers publish processed inputs and final results for probabilistic renewable hosting capacity under dynamic line ratings. The free Zenodo ZIP uses CC BY-NC 4.0. It contains Zaragoza-region weather derived from Renewables.ninja, a CIGRE medium-voltage test network, conductor and load assumptions, capacity-risk curves, ampacity distributions and sensitivity results. MATLAB scripts regenerate selected data-driven figures and tables. These outputs can benchmark thermal-rating and risk-constrained grid-planning simulations. Related catalogue model-pandapower is one tool used in the study’s power-flow comparison, not the owner of this results package. Coverage is a benchmark network driven by a selected regional weather record. Limitations include an exact weather period that is not stated in the summary, and full optimiser workspaces are excluded. Correlation assumptions and thermal-risk estimates require independent assessment. No archive was downloaded or simulation reproduced.
